name: Ink
author: James Myers
description: Sign and fill a PDF without leaving the desktop. Drop a document on the bar, draw your signature, type into the blanks, save. The original file is never rewritten - the annotated copy contains it byte for byte, as an incremental update.

schema.label: Ink colour
schema.description: The colour you sign in. Near-black rather than pure black, which is what a real pen looks like on a scan.

schema.label: Pen width
schema.description: Stroke width in points at 100% zoom.

schema.label: Text size
schema.description: Point size for typed text, which is about right for most form fields.

schema.label: Save next to the original
schema.description: Writes name-signed.pdf beside the source. The source is never modified either way.
